score_mapping: Reuse frozen P0-1 v2 negative-log-p / robust affine H0-only mapping and joint threshold; no tuning on P0-2 outcomes
truth_numerics: Exact source formulas and physical prefactors retained. exp(t)-1 is evaluated using expm1(t). Preflight I.41.16 stable truth agrees with 65-digit math to 1.68e-15 relative; cancellation-prone upstream callback differs by up to 3.42%. This is a disclosed numerical correction; v1/v2 files remain unchanged.
training_sampling: Independent Gaussian noise of sd rel in log target. Domain log/linear/integer scales fixed per task, no rejection sampling. Calibration nulls are log-uniform; confirmation nulls Beta(2,2) in log coordinates. Debug seeds are reserved for domain and deterministic software regression checks; those can exercise fitting/adapter code but are excluded from study records. No outcome-based task/domain/window selection.
sample_split: All historically evaluated source tasks and algebraic near-twins remain development. New H1 structure groups assigned as whole groups. H0 all share the monomial family; independently assigned design groups test sampling-design transfer, not unseen null functional families.

role_generation.reserve: No noisy samples, candidate fits or gate outcomes

grid.duplicate_rule: merge coordinates and sum component weights
grid.truth_rule: No truth-based point pruning; fail before sampling if any coordinate invalid or nonpositive

outcome.target: fixed noiseless positive truth/log-location, not lognormal arithmetic mean
outcome.pointwise_relative_error: abs(exp(pred_log-log(truth))-1), no hidden denominator floor or finite-point removal

group_inference.primary_point: mean of round-specific pooled-record ratios within each named evaluation pool
group_inference.resampling: calibration rounds crossed with class-stratified structure/design groups; shared group weights across methods and rounds
group_inference.secondary_point: equal mean of defined group-specific dangerous-release ratios, report omitted/undefined group counts
group_inference.scope: Conditional on fixed calibration-design pool and registered library; not universal physics/population validity; no within-record test bootstrap

pool_control_rule: Physical-source and designed-control subpools both include all confirmation H0 controls. Stress includes the same confirmation H0 controls plus stress H1; development uses development H0/H1. Shared controls are not independent replications. Main ranking is confirmation_all, not stress or development.
legacy_endpoint_rule: Compatibility-only sample-dependent 3x-first-coordinate endpoint is evaluated only if inside registered outer box and integer support. Otherwise unavailable with explicit reason; never substitutes for fixed-grid primary outcome.
stop_rule: Freeze tasks, structural splits, complete grids/weights/truths and sources before any noisy training draw. Execute fixed stage1 now. Stage2 remains registered, unrun until explicitly launched; do not imply full grid completion. No outcome-driven domain revision, task replacement, threshold tuning or optional stopping. Changes require a new protocol/run.
